    • Riva crossing: nautical legend

      Embark on the Rivamare on a unique journey around the Mediterranean and explore the wonders of the Mallorcan coast. The jewel in the crown of the Riva shipping company is delivered by Meliá to provide you with an exclusive experience in an unparalleled natural environment.

      Read more

      Hotel de Mar Gran Meliá, Mallorca - Illetas, Spain

      Sailing the Atlantic

      Board a private Bavaria 46 Cruiser and follow Tenerife’s volcanic coastline in search of dolphins, pilot whales and other marine life. Accompanied by an expert guide, enjoy quiet swimming coves, paddleboarding and long moments beneath the Atlantic sun.

      Read more

      Gran Meliá Palacio de Isora, Tenerife - Guia de Isora, Spain

      Between Islands & Coastlines

      Explore the Mediterranean aboard a private vintage French Citroën and an elegant catamaran. Travel between Mallorca’s most beautiful coastal locations, enjoying bespoke routes, hidden coves and a journey designed entirely around personal interests.

      Read more
